s: Who among the following authored the book 'Jinendra Kalyanabhyudayamu'?
x:
Appayacharya, a noted Jain scholar, authored Jinendra Kalyanabhyudayamu, an important work of Jain literature. The work describes the glory of Lord Mahavira (Jinendra) and reflects the influence of Jainism in medieval Andhra. It is regarded as one of the significant contributions to Telugu Jain literature.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

s: Which Telugu scholar wrote the poem "Vikramarjuna Vijayam" in Kannada?
x:
Adikavi Pampa, one of the greatest Kannada poets, authored Vikramarjuna Vijaya (also known as Pampa Bharata) in Kannada. Although closely associated with the Telugu region through the Vemulavada Chalukyas, Pampa composed his masterpiece in Kannada under the patronage of Arikesari II. The work retells the Mahabharata, portraying Arjuna as the central hero.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
